chronology: Publication methods and results were previously inspected in source discovery. The present source-surface inspection incidentally displayed the full Sample Population Statistics section, and two reviewers read it before this freeze. All selected count cells and adjacent WHO/incidence statistics were exposed. This is used-source selection, not preregistration or an untouched holdout. No selected-cell capture, empirical arithmetic or fit preceded this protocol commit.
objective: Add empirical joint observed-label information for both directions of glycemic-label change, preserving category dependence, as one step toward the full progression/reversal objective. Do not redefine scientific completion around this conditional table.

design_trace.scope: Health observation foundation only; no food, payer, economic or later-phase mechanism activated

bibliography.title: Risk Factors for the Progression or Regression to Diabetes or Normoglycaemia for Men with Impaired Fasting Glucose
bibliography.citation: Harland JW et al. Journal of Diabetes Research. 2025;2025:9926306. doi:10.1155/jdr/9926306.

source.rights: Literal article notice permits use, distribution and reproduction under the Creative Commons Attribution License with citation; version unspecified. Preserve the unmodified XML and its copyright/license notice. Publication permission does not grant participant-record access.

selection.selected_paragraph_prefix: Most men with normoglycaemia at baseline remained in that category
selection.required_denominator_crosscheck: The first paragraph of sec3.4 reports assessed-pair total, normoglycaemia-start total, IFG-ADA-start total and baseline-diabetes total. sec2.2 independently reports the assessed-pair total and the baseline-diabetes exclusion from the progression analysis. Compare literal integers; never infer missing categories or round percentage cells.
selection.capture: Extract the six literal n cells and two starting-row n totals by category-specific unique semantic bindings; also capture only the required assessed, baseline-diabetes and progression-analysis totals for reconciliation.
selection.zero_completion: No absent category, missing assessment, death or treatment cell is assigned zero. Only the complete explicitly enumerated non-diabetic-start rows enter the observed table.

estimand.population: Published paired, sufficiently assessed male Geelong Osteoporosis Study subset with source baseline normoglycaemia or IFG-ADA
estimand.time_period: Study baseline at original 2001-2006 or later 2007-2010 assessment; source 15-year follow-up phase finalised in 2022
estimand.target: Unweighted conditional follow-up label distributions given the source baseline ADA label and paired-assessed selection, averaging over the source's actual entry/follow-up timing mixture
estimand.classification: Source diabetes is FPG or self-reported diabetes or antihyperglycemic medication; it is not independently confirmed incident T2D. Baseline diabetes includes type 1. Source labels do not enforce persistent diagnosis history. One follow-up blood test without repeat confirmation is a measurement limitation.
estimand.conditioning: Condition on the two published baseline-row totals and the source's assessable, retained subset; do not generalize to the recruited cohort or count deaths/unassessed men as unchanged.
estimand.treatment: The regression-analysis medication statement does not establish medication-free status throughout follow-up; lower glucose labels are not untreated clinical recovery/remission.
estimand.timing: No individual clocks, exact event dates or common exposure duration are supplied to this likelihood. Never substitute nominal 15 years or median follow-up.

working_likelihood.equation: L(P|C,n)=product_i[n_i!/product_j c_ij! * product_j p_ij^c_ij], with sum_j p_ij=1 for each row
assumptions: Independent observations within each selected baseline row
A common marginal row probability for the published timing/age/selection mixture
Conditional independence of the two disjoint baseline groups given their row totals
working_likelihood.mle: p_ij=c_ij/n_i; two free probabilities per row, with the third determined by the row sum
working_likelihood.joint_covariance: Plug-in covariance for estimated row probabilities: (diag(p_i)-p_i p_i^T)/n_i; conditional cross-row blocks are zero under the declared working model
working_likelihood.intervals: Marginal exact binomial Clopper-Pearson intervals using each multinomial cell versus all other cells, with Bonferroni alpha across all six selected cells. Report as working-model simultaneous coverage, not selection/measurement/transport uncertainty.
working_likelihood.alternative: Descriptive-only mode reports exact published counts and derived fractions with no likelihood, covariance or intervals; make unavailable inferential outputs explicit.
working_likelihood.evaluation: Source reproduction, independent mathematical normalization/likelihood/covariance tests and no engine-change checks. No compatible independent clinical evaluation has been selected; keep it unresolved.

failure_conditions: Source hash, size, identity or license mismatch
Missing/duplicated section or semantic count binding
Negative/noninteger counts or incomplete explicit row
Row totals or independent same-source denominator checks disagree
Invalid simplex or nonfinite numerical result
retained_full_requirements: Joint clinical uncertainty and independent trajectory evaluation
